exp.desc:
- Up to 120 products a day
- Studio flash, tethering, colour management

cl.p1: on a good day I shoot 120 products, cut out, colour-accurate and so that a chair on the listing looks the same as in the customer’s living room. I have done product photography for an online homeware retailer for four years.
cl.p2: I work with studio flash, tethered capture and a standard workflow through to delivery to the shop. Larger products and room sets are what draw me to your studio. My portfolio is attached.

cl.p1: setting up lights, running cables, managing the tether, fetching coffee if needed: I know what assisting looks like and that is exactly where I want to start. My photography degree taught me that I prefer people in front of the camera to still life.
cl.p2: Your corporate portraits have a calm I rarely see. I would love to learn how you manage that in twenty minutes with a nervous chief executive.
